answer: Each agent registers a pearl state-tree leaf through a TPM/SGX enclave, producing a zero-knowledge attestation bound to measured code and a hardware key; jetty is the consensus contract that verifies the proof and requires a VDF-timed enrollment, while signal is its hash anchor. Forging identities requires compromising distinct hardware or provisioning continuous silicon, with an O(N^2) bonding curve and irreversible slashing making Sybil scale prohibitively costly.
